text:
Claire H.: Heads up — promo credits tied to acct-redwood-dedicated expire in 8 days. We have a reserved capacity invoice scheduled next week; will the credits auto-apply to that invoice or get lost? invoice INV-2026-4098

billing-bot: Auto-notice: promo credits (CR-PEX-2026) expire in 8 days. Check billing console or contact billing@redwood.com :alarm_clock:

Tom I.: Which credits exactly? promo vs contract credits? We have a reserved commit for Q3; if promo can't be applied to committed invoice we might want to move some usage to hosted to consume them first.

Maria (Billing): Short answer: promo credits are applied to invoices automatically but there are ordering rules. Contract (reserved capacity) invoices are charged from committed ledger; promo vouchers typically apply to hosted usage first because of acct priority. I need to check ledger mapping for INV-2026-4098.

Ken S.: Can we do a manual allocation/transfer from promo -> reserved pool before expiry? I recall a "credit transfer" flow but not sure if it works across product types.

Maria (Billing): Manual transfer only for contract credits attached to an org or subacct. Promo vouchers (the ones with code format CR-PEX-*) can't be allocated to reserved contracts retroactively. Two options: (1) accelerate usage on hosted to consume before expiry (2) escalate for a conversion exception — requires Sales + Legal sign-off.

Claire H.: Hmm. We can't easily spin up extra hosted usage for production workloads. Can we delay the reserved invoice or change billing period?

Maria (Billing): We sometimes have a one-cycle adjustment but reserved commits are calendar-aligned and limited flexibility. I'll check with finance-ops now.

billing-bot: Ledger query output:
```
$ redwood billing ledger query --account acct-redwood-dedicated --credit CR-PEX-2026 --list
balance: 48000.00 USD
attached: false
expiry: 2026-10-05
```

Tom I.: If attached=false that explains it — voucher isn't linked to the reserved contract. Can we attach it?

Maria (Billing): Attach requires converting the voucher to a contract credit. There is a precedent for enterprise promoes — conversion needs an amendment. I'll open a ticket with Sales + Legal. ETA 48-72h. If approved we can backdate application to cover INV-2026-4098.

Claire H.: :eyes: Okay please escalate — cost team prefers not to eat this. Also what's the worst-case charge if we fail to convert?

Maria (Billing): Worst-case: invoice posts, promo credit expires unused => customer pays the invoice. Finance will treat as standard revenue; internally we'll have to cover/absorb if sales/legal pushes for remediation but that's not guaranteed.

Ken S.: If timeline is tight, fallback: consume credits by running low-risk hosted workloads that will use ~10k USD over next 7 days. I can script safe synthetic requests to embeddings/generation that are throttled.

Tom I.: Agree on dual approach. Ken, please prepare the script but don't run until Maria confirms conversion path is blocked. Claire, I'll coordinate infra to spin minimal hosted capacity if needed.

Maria (Billing): Ticket opened: TCK-12872 — "Convert CR-PEX-2026 to contract credit for acct-redwood-dedicated". Added Sales and Legal. I'll post updates and any approval screenshots here.

Claire H.: Thanks everyone. Please keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
